arguments.summary: RenderEngine normalizes requested dimensions through Geometry::clampDimension(int), returns before mutating layout or publishing when both dimensions equal the current viewport, and otherwise updates viewport and layout before exactly one matching event. WindowController and public interfaces are preserved. Revised the obsolete zero/negative initial-resize test expectations to require no event; all 8 visible tests pass.
